thread:
Maya: Quick sync — planning a pressure sweep Friday 03:00 UTC to reproduce the weird p99 token-time spike. Goal: cold vs warm cache, NVML traces, and a small regression diff vs last golden run.
Liam: Got it. Which endpoint + traffic shape should I encode in the k6 scenario?
Maya: Use /v1/generate with model rdl-7b-quant-v2. Traffic: ramp 20 -> 1500 vus over 10m, hold 45m, 5m cool-down. Run cold (set REDWOOD_CACHE_MODE=off) then warm 30m later. Save sample responses.
Sophia: Ill take traces (Jaeger) and flamegraphs. Will collect Prom, node_exporter, NVML. Add p99/p995 token-time panels and a Prom alert when p99 > 1.5s.
Raj: I can reserve dedicated nodes. How many GPUs do we want?
Maya: Try to reserve 8xA100 on staging-dedicated. If not possible, fallback to shared-hosted but tag the run.
Liam: I'll run a low-scale dry-run tonight 18:30 PT to validate headers and auth. Who owns artifact upload?
Sophia: I will. Use --out json=run.json in k6 and upload to s3://redwood-load/tests/pressure-1813456789/. Attach run_id to traces.
infra-bot: k6 image v0.36.0 ready. Reservation request filed (ticket PLAT-627). Dry-run slot 2025-06-12T01:30Z confirmed.
Liam: Example k6 command for the big run:
```
k6 run --vus 1500 --duration 60m --out json=run.json scripts/rdl_pressure.js 
# for cold: env REDWOOD_CACHE_MODE=off
```
Maya: Add KV cache snapshot before/after each pass and include kv.hit_rate, kv.miss_rate, kv.avg_lookup_ms.
Sophia: Will add KV snapshot script that queries /internal/kv/metrics and dumps to s3. Also will include NVML CSV and container-level usage.
Liam: Pushed a small node-exporter nvml scrape tweak to infra repo. @SRE Team can you review?
SRE Team: Reviewing change now. NVML scrape looks fine but need to ensure collector labels match staging naming.
Raj: Nodes reserved: 8xA100 confirmed on staging-dedicated. I'll watch capacity during the run and bump if we see saturation.
Maya: Checklist: [ ] dry-run tonight (Liam) [ ] nodes reserved (Raj) [ ] cold pass 03:00 UTC (Maya) [ ] warm pass 03:35 UTC (Maya/Sophia) [ ] traces + NVML + KV snapshots (Sophia) [ ] upload artifacts (Sophia) [ ] postmortem & perf diff (Sophia)
Liam: Added smaller payload variant for dry-run in repo: https://git.redwood/infra/load-tests/rdl_pressure_scripts. I'll post dry-run logs here after.
Sophia: I'll pre-create Grafana panels and the PromQL for p99 delta vs golden. Will also add an ad-hoc alert rule: increase if p99_delta > 20% for >5m.
Maya: Can someone volunteer to author the short postmortem and regression checklist?
Sophia: I will own postmortem and regression checklist.
infra-bot: Dry-run finished (status: success) at 2025-06-11T01:32Z. Artifact: s3://redwood-load/tests/pressure-1813456789/dryrun.json.
Maya: Great. Proceeding with scheduled pressure sweep at 03:00 UTC. I'll post run_id when started.
Raj: Ill be oncall for the window. Escalation path: PagerDuty -> eng-runtime lead. Post any urgent alerts to #incidents.
Liam: Calendar invite sent for the run. I'll post the k6 stdout/summary to this thread.
Sophia: Preparing the dashboard tweaks and alert updates now. Will attach flamegraphs after traces processed.
Maya: During the run, flag any anomaly and include timestamped sample id. Post-run owner: Sophia — please produce the perf diff and short writeup. Thread will stay open until the postmortem is posted.
Sophia: Will do. Thanks everyone.
Maya: Closing coordinating thread for now. Will reopen if anything blocks.
